weavers_rest_draught.process: Simmered in a hearth cauldron with purified spring water.
weavers_rest_draught.effect: A gentle liquid nervine used to soothe an overactive mind, calm restless villagers, and invite peaceful sleep.

st_johns_ease_balm.process: Gently melted and infused over low hearth heat, then poured into tins to set.
st_johns_ease_balm.effect: A cooling, tactile balm used by field workers and kitchen hands to relieve minor burns, sunburns, and skin inflammation.

morning_hearth_smoke.process: Chopped, dried, bound, and rolled with melted tree pitch into a slow-burning smudge bundle.
morning_hearth_smoke.effect: A warm, aromatic smoke used to clear stagnant cottage air, welcome visitors, and provide a mental energy boost.
